cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Terms and Conditions
cards.instruction: Treat every offer, favor, feeling, and apology as a negotiation.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. I'll accept your apology for missing my birthday if I get first choice of Christmas dates.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Mum already expects me Christmas Day.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. Boxing Day, then. In exchange, I'll tell her I'm no longer hurt.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'd rather you actually stopped being hurt.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Stay through New Year and I'll mean it. I'll even stop mentioning the birthday to Mum.

mechanism: A authorizes forgiveness in tiers, negotiating family time and emotional sincerity as privileges under personal control.
confusable: Withholding forgiveness alone is insufficient; each counteroffer must change the terms of the emotional agreement while A grants approval.
comparison: A family apology trades holiday presence, unlike the equipment loan practical fees and reassurance discount.
seedUse: Use D22-b Christmas obligations and genuine-feeling request, shaping concessions as approved levels of forgiveness.
